newsitem.title: ITALY: FAO says Bulgaria facing wheat shortages.
newsitem.headline: FAO says Bulgaria facing wheat shortages.

text.p: Bulgarian wheat production has dropped significantly in the past year, raising fears for the country's food supply, the United Nations Food and Agricultural Organisation (FAO) said in a report on Wednesday.
The Rome-based agency said wheat production for 1996/97 was forecast at 1.9 million tonnes, short of domestic consumption needs totalling an estimated 2.5 million tonnes.
The report said unfavourable weather conditions and a depressed agricultural sector had led to a reduced wheat crop and pushed up prices of bread.
"As bread is the preferred stable food, ensuring continued access to adequate wheat supplies is of crucial importance for the majority of the population," FAO said.

The 1997/98 wheat crop was expected to improve to 3 million tonnes due to improved weather and an increase in planting, the report said. This would be adequate to meet domestic consumption requirements, it added.
